prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical Instagram cover image
Primary request: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 image (1080x1350 or closest). Japanese-style kyotei motorboat racing on a coastal course with a big dramatic sky, strong wind, and choppy water.
Scene/backdrop: coastal race course under a huge dark dramatic windblown sky; rough choppy water.
Subject: one single-seat Japanese kyotei racing boat, about 3 m long, flat, low and long relative to the racer, with a light white or pale-grey hull. It must not resemble an offshore powerboat or an F1 tunnel boat. OPEN cockpit only: no canopy, no roof, no windshield bubble. The racer crouches or kneels low in the open cockpit, leaning forward with both hands on a small steering wheel, wearing a completely plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit; face not visible. One outboard motor mounted on the stern creates a large white spray plume. The boat banks into a tight left turn around an orange-and-white cylindrical turn buoy, with spray curving outward.
Style/medium: highly realistic editorial sports photography with natural textures and convincing hydrodynamics.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5; boat entirely in the lower half; the top 45% must remain dark, simple, and uncluttered as clean negative space for a future title.
Lighting/mood: dramatic coastal storm light, energetic and windswept.
Text: none.
Constraints: no recognizable real person; preserve accurate Japanese kyotei boat proportions and open-cockpit construction.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, branding, readable markings, canopy, roof, windshield bubble, offshore powerboat form, F1 tunnel boat form.
verification: Visually inspected the generated image. It shows a low, long, light-colored single-seat open-cockpit kyotei boat banking through a tight left turn beside an orange-and-white cylindrical buoy, with a crouched helmeted racer, one stern outboard motor, and a large curving white spray plume. Strong wind, choppy coastal water, and a dramatic sky are visible; the boat remains in the lower half and the upper 45% is dark and uncluttered. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, or flags were observed.
